$comment: Paint Your Sails (Q0.2): the palette stand beside Nell's door. For the Copilot app course, the app's theme in Settings → Themes; here, your sails. finished: the first time you select Finish. newViewLate: saves from before app 1.1.25 meet the New view here, after the theme step.

newViewLate.caption: Select **Continue**, and the app opens the **New** view. New work starts here.

text.hint1: The palette stand’s by Nell’s door. Any colours will do, it’s your ship.
text.hint2: See the sparkle by Nell’s door? Pick a palette there, then select Finish.
text.hint3Walk: Walk up to the sparkling stand and press E.
text.hint3: I’ve opened the palette stand for you. Pick one and select Finish.
